title: Cuttwood Bar Salts Cuttwood Crush 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Cuttwood Nic Salt Cuttwood Crush offers a tropical fusion of pineapple, mango, and guava flavours. This e-liquid combines the tangy taste of pineapple with the sweet and juicy notes of mango and guava, creating a vibrant and exotic vaping experience. Cuttwood Nic Salt e-liquids are crafted with a balanced 50VG/50PG mix, making them perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping devices and pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, offering an effective alternative for adult smokers and vapers. Hailing from the USA, Cuttwood are renowned for their high-quality e-liquids and distinctive flavour profiles. Their dedication to excellence has earned them a loyal following among vapers worldwide. Now available in the UK, Cuttwood Nic Salts bring their premium flavours to a broader audience in the form of nicotine salt vape liquids, ideal for use with various MTL vape devices.
